src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2024_us_sldu_500k
sldu.vint: The Census Bureau's 2024 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2024 legislative session year.
rec: Tennessee General Assembly, bill information SB0780 (112th General Assembly): Public Chapter 596

A three-judge panel (Wygant v. Lee) ruled in Nov. 2023 that this map broke the Tennessee Constitution's Senate numbering rule and ordered a new map by Jan. 31, 2024, but the Tennessee Supreme Court halted that, so the 2022 map was used in 2024 (the court-order details come from a news report). Census file basis: the cached 2024 legislative file says LSY 2024 (checked: TN sldu 33 districts, LSY 2024); the 119th Congress file is the plan the Congress elected in November 2024 sits under.
